sections.title: Two words for sorry
sections.content: *Bocsánat* apologizes for something you've done — bumping into someone, a real mistake. *Elnézést* is for getting someone's attention or excusing a small interruption, closer to English "excuse me" than "I'm sorry". If someone apologizes to you, *semmi baj* ("no worries") is the natural reply.

Reach for *elnézést* far more often than *bocsánat* — starting a question to a stranger, squeezing past someone, getting a waiter's attention. Save *bocsánat* for when you've actually done something worth apologizing for. Among friends, *bocsánat* is often shortened to the casual *bocsi*.
